title: RBI’s interest-rate cycle: from five cuts to its first hike in over three years
dek: How the Reserve Bank went from cutting rates to raising them in 20 months, and what it means for your loans and the economy.
seoTitle: RBI repo rate timeline 2025–2026: every cut, hold and hike
bigLabel: Repo rate after the 7 Oct hike

glance.what: On 7 Oct 2026 the RBI raised its key rate to 5.50%, its first increase since February 2023, after cutting it five times in 2025.
glance.why: Inflation picked up sharply through mid-2026. Borrowers with repo-linked floating loans may see higher EMIs at their next reset.
glance.next: The next policy meeting is 2–4 Dec 2026. The new “calibrated tightening” stance leaves room for another hike.

forYou: Home and car loans linked to the repo rate may cost more at their next reset, depending on your loan terms. Fixed-rate loans you already have are not affected.

events.title: RBI starts cutting rates as inflation cools
events.summary: The Monetary Policy Committee cuts the repo rate by 0.25 percentage points, starting an easing cycle.

events.title: A second 0.25-point cut
events.summary: With retail inflation still easing, the RBI cuts again.

events.title: A big 0.50-point cut, then a signal to slow down
events.summary: The MPC front-loads a larger cut but switches its stance from accommodative to neutral, saying room for more cuts is limited.

events.title: Rates on hold amid US tariff uncertainty
events.summary: The RBI keeps the rate at 5.50% at two meetings while earlier cuts work through the banking system.

events.title: The last cut of the cycle
events.summary: A unanimous 0.25-point cut takes total easing since February to 1.25 percentage points.

events.title: Hold as the rupee hits a record low
events.summary: The RBI holds at 5.25% with the rupee near 92 to the dollar and geopolitical risks rising.

events.title: Two more holds as energy prices climb
events.summary: On 8 April and 5 June the RBI stays put, citing global uncertainty and elevated energy prices linked to the West Asia conflict.

events.title: Fifth hold in a row; RBI wants more clarity on inflation
events.summary: The MPC holds unanimously and says it needs more clarity on the path of inflation before acting.

events.title: Inflation jumps
events.summary: Retail inflation averages 4.9% in July–September, up from 3.9% the quarter before. Wholesale inflation tops 10%.

events.title: Forecasters start calling for a hike
events.summary: S&P expects a rise to 5.50%. Fitch sees 5.75% by early 2027. SBI Research recommends hikes in both October and December.

events.title: RBI raises rates for the first time since February 2023
events.summary: A unanimous 0.25-point hike to 5.50%. The stance shifts to “calibrated tightening” on a 4–2 vote, which signals that rate cuts are off the table for now.
events.differs: The FY27 inflation projection is listed as 5.0% by PRS but reported as 5.2% by Swarajya and Deccan Herald. Check the RBI statement before citing.
